1: The door back out to Warrior City.
V: Cold stone, and the smell of old candles.
y: Stained glass: eight figures holding hands in a ring. One of the faces has been scratched out.
A: The altar. A white cloth, two candles, and a small bell.
P: A pew, polished by a great many knees.

objects.name: Wren
lines: Welcome. Take it slowly. The first steps are always the strangest.
Wren. I keep the old lights. There's something under this chapel. I can feel it, like a draught from a door nobody's opened.

objects.name: Old Bell-Ringer
lines: I ring the bell at dawn and dusk. Nobody wakes up for it any more.

answer: The Eight. The kingdoms that held hands. Somebody scratched out one face, long before my time.

questions.ask: Ring it quieter. Some of us were asleep.
answer: Five hundred years, some of you.
I'll ring it twice tomorrow. Just for you.

objects.name: The Keeper
lines: What? You thought I couldn't leave that place?
I have a life outside of you.
